# package can

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/can"
```

Package can fingerprints CAN-over-TCP gateways that expose a Controller Area Network bus through an SLCAN (Lawicel) ASCII serial interface over a TCP socket — CAN-Ethernet bridges and SocketCAN-over-TCP daemons.

Detection sends the SLCAN version command ("V\\r") and, when needed, the serial command ("N\\r"), and accepts only a strict SLCAN reply: the command's echo letter followed by the fixed-width hexadecimal field and a carriage return, or a bare CR acknowledgement to a second command. ASCII banners of HTTP, SSH, SMTP, line protocols and the like are rejected, so a chatty text service does not read as a CAN gateway.

In identify mode the firmware version and serial number reported by the gateway are recorded.
